title: Respawn Anchor Indicator
description: A Texturepack that Indicates if a Respawn Anchor is Charged or not
body:
**A Resourcepack that Modifys the Respawn Anchor to indicate if its charged or not 
the respawn anchor will turn green when its charged or stay red if its not charged. when the respawn anchor is on the ground or in your inventory it will show the basic texture and not the indicator one** _**(this is compatible with other packs and can be used as an overlay)**_
